facts.text: I need a CV for the job Junior PHP Engineer (f/m/d).
The job is a permanent contract in Germany.
The job is full-time or part-time.
The job locations are Cologne, Düsseldorf, Darmstadt, or Remote (in Germany).
The company operates Kaufland.de.
The company has a development team of over 300 experts.
The job involves working in cross-functional teams with product managers, product designers, frontend and backend engineers, data scientists, and lean managers.
The job involves pair-programming sessions.
The job involves planning and building scalable and reliable software solutions.
The job profile mentions object-oriented programming, preferably with PHP.
The job profile mentions modern frameworks such as Symfony or Laravel.
The job profile mentions knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL.
The job profile emphasizes clean coding principles and best practices.
The job profile emphasizes communication skills and working in an international, English-speaking team.
The company offers an attractive relocation package for moving to Germany.
The company provides free choice of hardware and a development environment of the candidate's choice.
The company offers Top conditions at Urban Sports Club for fitness, team sports, yoga, and more.
The company offers a referral program called Refer an Engineer Program.
The referral program offers a bonus up to 1.300,- € per referral.
The referral bonus is paid after successful recruitment, with the first part after the first salary and the second part after the buddy passes the trial period.
The contact person for the application is Alina Asmus.
The postal address listed is Habsburgerring 2, 50674 Köln.
The employer name listed is Kaufland e-commerce Services GmbH & Co. KG.
